record.reason: All original inertia and contact probes pass unchanged bounds at 2880 nodes; 1440-node failures retained

limitations: Native reduced-mass projection is an independent assembly check with shared geometry, not independent dynamic or measured validation.
All original cases and old failures are retained; unknown geometric applicability cannot pass.
Finite contact iterations, stabilization, ground compliance and zero-speed pin friction remain model limitations.
Two timesteps and a refined interpolation table do not establish dynamic convergence.
The original native 192 runs and their audit-v2 0/10/182 and legacy 10/3/3 results remain unchanged.
